result.summary: This is a routine dishwasher fault, and the landlord hasn't answered the approval request from 29 Nov after 3 days. This was the first deadline missed, so I sent the landlord a reminder asking for APPROVE/DECLINE, updated the tenant with safe interim advice, and set a 3-day hold. If there's still no reply then, a human should take over.

judgement.why_this_decision: Approval #8 is still pending with no landlord reply since event 004 (29 Nov). Event 006 is the first missed follow-up deadline. The rules say to escalate only after two missed deadlines, and the landlord can still answer this, so a reminder and a hold is the proportionate step. The tenant hadn't had an update, so I sent one.

alternatives_considered.why_not: This is only the first missed deadline. The job is routine and not a safety risk, and the landlord can still respond.
There is no approval or pre-approved spend limit on record, and the job isn't an emergency.
Approval #8 is already pending, and only one can be open per ticket. I chased it with a message instead.

checks_performed: No open holds before this action
No pre-approved spend limit or preferred channel on the landlord profile
Severity is routine; no leak or safety issue reported
No earlier jobs at this property and no attachments
assumptions: Email is a suitable channel because the original approval request went by email and no preferred channel is recorded

result.situation: The tenant reported on 29 Nov that the dishwasher never finishes its cycle. On the same day the agency emailed landlord Turner asking if a contractor could attend. There has been no reply in 3 days, and the system flagged the case for manual review.

actions_taken.result: Stage is landlord_approval, approval #8 is pending, and there were no holds

actions_taken.description: Sent the landlord a reminder by email asking them to reply APPROVE/DECLINE for a contractor visit
Updated the tenant by email with the status, safe interim advice (switch the dishwasher off, watch for leaks) and when to expect the next update
Placed a hold waiting on the landlord, with a follow-up in 3 days

escalation.reason: First missed deadline only. The landlord has been chased.
escalation.recommendation: If the landlord still hasn't replied at the follow-up on 5 Dec, escalate so a human can phone the landlord.

unverified: The landlord and tenant email addresses are not in the CRM, so delivery isn't confirmed
The dishwasher make and warranty status are unknown
Whether the tenant sent photos isn't visible in the records
risks_or_red_flags: Contact details for the landlord and tenant are missing from the CRM
A dishwasher left running continuously could leak. The tenant has been told to switch it off.
result.final_status: landlord_approval, on hold waiting on the landlord (hold 48)

next_follow_up.what: Check for the landlord's reply to approval #8. If there's none, escalate to a human to phone the landlord. If they've approved, assign a contractor.
